## P1 — Полнота и конкурентность crawling

> **Phase Assurance | v1.**
> Impact: internal-integration
> Integration Seams: crawler.fresh-run · crawler.recovery · database.run-leases
> Live or Irreversible: no

## Sequence and dependencies

P1.1 → P1.2; P1.3 consumes both truthful fresh outcomes; P1.4 consumes recovery ownership and
finishes scheduler/manual concurrency protection.

## DoR (Definition of Ready)

- [x] Все четыре findings имеют distinct item и negative regression.
- [x] `Completed`/incomplete semantics и execution ownership разделены.
- [x] Scope compatibility и no-drop stack behavior проверяются отдельно.
- [x] No live EIS request входит в automated Validation.

## Phase Handoff

После P1.4: direct-close фазы и затем P2.1. Audit возможен только по отдельному доказанному
residual risk и адресному owner consent.
